title: PID Namespace Subprocess Sandboxing (Linux, v2.1.98)
description: When CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB=1 is set (already active on requiem), Claude Code now additionally applies PID namespace isolation to subprocesses on Linux. Processes spawned by Bash tool run in a PID namespace, preventing them from seeing or signaling processes outside their sandbox. Meaningful security hardening for requiem (native Linux) where the existing env-scrub is active.
comparison_notes: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB is already in registry (v2.1.88). This adds PID namespace isolation as an additional security layer when that env var is set — same config key, meaningfully stronger behavior. Registry entry needs updating to note the v2.1.98 PID namespace addition.
